axes.name: match_thr
axes.hypothesis: Association threshold controls ID switches vs missed reassociations.
axes.expected: HOTA +0.02..0.10 if IDSW dominates; AssA/DetA may move the other way.

axes.name: det_thr
axes.hypothesis: Detection threshold trades recall for precision.
axes.expected: Higher: fewer false tracks; lower: more recall. HOTA change depends on DetA vs AssA.

axes.name: init_thr
axes.expected: Higher: cleaner IDs, risk missed starts; lower: more coverage.

axes.name: post_tau
axes.hypothesis: Gaussian interpolation width controls gap filling.
axes.expected: Smaller tau: more conservative fill; larger tau: longer/softer fills.

axes.name: post_interval
axes.expected: Larger interval recovers longer gaps but risks wrong IDs.

axes.name: kf_type
axes.expected: Variant best for MOT pedestrian motion may differ from NSA.

axes.name: continue_lr
axes.hypothesis: Continue from the best checkpoint with a lower LR and a fresh cosine.
axes.expected: Small HOTA gain if the baseline is under-trained; risk of drift.

axes.name: reproduce_seed
axes.hypothesis: Reproduce the best training recipe with a different seed.
axes.expected: Estimate seed noise before promoting small gains.
